Referenced by {@link pol_eco_board_boards} for structural organization. Immutable except for changes to name, description, or display order. Board and user content models reference this category but do not own category records. Provides hierarchical and navigational structure but contains no user-generated content. Used system-wide for filtering, searching, and permission gating.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the category as displayed to users. Title-cased, 2–60 characters, represents top-level classification (e.g., 'International Affairs').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Free-text category description for web UI and moderation guidance. Explains topic focus, allowed content themes, and usage. Optional but strongly recommended; up to 255 characters.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Integer specifying appearance order in navigation and category lists (ascending). Configurable by admins for optimal UX.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of initial category creation via admin workflow.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent update to any field (name, description, display_order).

models.name: pol_eco_board_boards
models.description: Defines a top-level forum board/section on the platform, each belonging to exactly one category ({@link pol_eco_board_categories}). A board is a logical container for posts, with unique name and code. Board configuration includes description, display order, visibility, and archival state. This model does not directly reference user participation or moderation assignments (handled in separate tables). Used for display navigation, permission gate, and board-level operations. Does not store content; used for board definitions only.

foreignFields.name: pol_eco_board_category_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned category's {@link pol_eco_board_categories.id}. Each board is assigned to exactly one active category for taxonomic organization and navigation.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique, human-readable board title. Displayed prominently in navigation. 2–60 characters, may overlap category names for consistency but globally unique per board.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique, machine-friendly identifier for the board; used in URLs, admin operations, and as an external integration key. 2–30 lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional board description for user guidance and moderation policy. Up to 255 characters.

plainFields.name: is_public
plainFields.description: Whether the board is visible to non-authenticated (guest) users. Used for UI filtering and role-based access control.

plainFields.name: is_archived
plainFields.description: True if the board is archived (closed for new posts/comments but viewable by privileged roles/admins). Used for compliance and operational reporting.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Integer that determines board order in the navigation lists. Lower values display earlier (ascending sort). Admin-configurable for UX.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of board creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to board settings, description, or archival state.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp if board is logically deleted (soft delete). Null unless deleted. Used for audit trails, never physically removed from database.

models.name: pol_eco_board_service_settings
models.description: Singleton table for global service configuration and feature toggles. Contains a single record (enforced in application logic) specifying current values for platform-level settings, system flags, and business-critical constants (e.g., max post length, registration enabled, enforcement deadlines, notification toggles, retention periods). Updated rarely by admins. No user-generated content. Read at app startup. All service domains reference this table for system-wide parameters but do not own or update these fields independently. Record is never deleted or replaced, only updated.

plainFields.name: registration_enabled
plainFields.description: Enables or disables new user registration across the platform. If false, registration endpoints and workflows are disabled for all users. Managed by admins during maintenance, emergencies, or policy changes.

plainFields.name: max_post_length
plainFields.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in a post's body as enforced by business and moderation policy.

plainFields.name: max_comment_length
plainFields.description: Maximum number of characters permitted in a comment's body. Used for input validation and error messaging.

plainFields.name: default_board_visibility
plainFields.description: Default value for new board's is_public field when created by admins. Guides admin workflow UX.

plainFields.name: data_retention_days
plainFields.description: System-wide setting (in days) for minimum data retention period for posts, comments, and audit logs before they're eligible for purge per policy. Audited by compliance systems.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when service settings record was first created. Set once.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of any change to configuration or business flags. Updated automatically on every change.

models.name: pol_eco_board_guests
models.description: Guest users who access the application without registration; provides a tracked, anonymous footprint for session observation, abuse/IP recording, and guest-to-member analytics. Powers project-level metrics for non-authenticated participation including consent status.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest for session tracking and abuse prevention.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Device fingerprint or anonymized browser identifier to distinguish unique guest sessions.

plainFields.name: consent_status
plainFields.description: Current consent or privacy agreement status text/code for this guest interaction.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the guest session record was last updated.

models.name: pol_eco_board_members
models.description: Registered member accounts, each a unique, verified user. Handles profile, security, lifecycle, audit, and privacy settings for all core platform business. Required for any posting, voting, or reporting.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique verified email address. Used for login and notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password (never plaintext); always required for authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Public display name; unique within platform locale.

plainFields.name: profile_image_uri
plainFields.description: Profile picture URI or file reference; optional at registration.

plainFields.name: consent_status
plainFields.description: Active privacy/consent agreement version for this member.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Is member active (not banned/deactivated/deleted)?

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Last successful login time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the member.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update to member account.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if the member is deleted or banned.

models.name: pol_eco_board_moderators
models.description: Moderator accounts elevated from members for content/business enforcement powers. Tracks appointment and privileges, with references to both the member and the appointing admin.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to pol_eco_board_members.id this moderator extends.

plainFields.name: appointed_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: Admin who granted moderator privileges; references pol_eco_board_admins.id.

plainFields.name: appointed_at
plainFields.description: Date/time when moderator role was granted.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: If privileges stripped; otherwise null when active.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: If this moderator's privileges are currently active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp the moderator record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last moderator record update.

models.name: pol_eco_board_admins
models.description: Platform/system admins with authority for all security/policy/analytics/role management. Each record links an admin to the promoting admin and to their member account for full accountability.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to member this admin extends (pol_eco_board_members.id).

plainFields.name: privilege_level
plainFields.description: Numeric admin privilege level (0=standard admin, up to 10 for full super admins).

plainFields.name: appointed_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: Admin who approved this account (self-referential for first/creator).

plainFields.name: appointed_at
plainFields.description: When admin privileges were first granted.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: If privileges are revoked or demoted, when it happened.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Is this admin active and able to exercise admin powers?

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Admin record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last admin record update.

models.name: pol_eco_board_auth_sessions
models.description: Tracks all authentication sessions for members (JWT, refresh tokens, SSO). Stores token hash, issued/expiry/revoke, IP/device metadata, audit info. Used for login management, security, and compliance.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to pol_eco_board_members.id representing the account for this session.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: Hash of last issued JWT access token (never raw/plaintext).

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: Hash of active refresh token (never plaintext).

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which session was created.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Device/browser fingerprint, for tracking unique sessions.

plainFields.name: provider
plainFields.description: Authentication provider used: 'native', 'google', 'sso-...', etc.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string for device/browser diagnostics.

plainFields.name: issued_at
plainFields.description: When this session/JWT was issued.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Session expiry timestamp.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: If revoked, when session/token was terminated; null if active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session record created at.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When session record was last updated.

models.name: pol_eco_board_role_transitions
models.description: Records all role (member/moderator/admin) transitions: promotions, demotions, requests, approvals. Tracks the account affected, approving admin, status, and all audit trail fields.

foreignFields.name: account_id
foreignFields.description: The affected account ID (member, moderator, or admin). {@link pol_eco_board_members.id} or derived types.

foreignFields.name: approved_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who approved this transition. {@link pol_eco_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: origin_role
plainFields.description: Original role for the affected account: guest, member, moderator, admin.

plainFields.name: destination_role
plainFields.description: Role after the transition: member, moderator, admin, revoked.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Explanation or business justification for transition (may be user-requested, policy, or system action).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Transition status: pending, completed, rejected, or cancelled.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: When the transition was initiated.

plainFields.name: approved_at
plainFields.description: Time transition was approved (null if not finalized).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Transition record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update for this transition record.

models.name: pol_eco_board_account_audits
models.description: Comprehensive audit trail recording all actions on members, moderators, admins. Logs who did it, who was affected, type/status of business action, and business/technical metadata for compliance/audit. Enables investigation, incident response, and retention.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: ID of the account performing the action. {@link pol_eco_board_members.id} or derived.

foreignFields.name: target_account_id
foreignFields.description: ID of the account affected. {@link pol_eco_board_members.id} or derived.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Business event: create, update, password_change, ban, privilege_escalation, role_transition, session_invalidate, etc.

plainFields.name: action_metadata
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded metadata or reference for audit: external system reference, business justification, etc.

plainFields.name: event_source
plainFields.description: Where event was triggered: API, admin UI, scheduled_job, external_integration, etc.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Outcome: success, failure, pending, error (for audit chains).

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: When this event took place.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When audit record was written.

models.name: pol_eco_board_board_statuses
models.description: Tracks the dynamic status of each board (such as open, locked, archived, visible, or hidden) for business logic and audit trail purposes. Each record represents a status change event for a single board, with effective time, responsible actor, and rationale for the change. Supports reporting and compliance tracking of board accessibility and moderation actions. Links to the target board, relevant actor (admin or moderator), and includes fields for status type, effective timestamp, and status detail.

foreignFields.name: pol_eco_board_board_id
foreignFields.description: Board's {@link pol_eco_board_boards.id} to which this status applies.

foreignFields.name: actor_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator's {@link pol_eco_board_moderators.id} responsible for this status change (if set by a moderator).

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link pol_eco_board_admins.id} responsible for this status change (if set by an admin).

plainFields.name: status_type
plainFields.description: Type of board status (e.g., open, locked, archived, visible, hidden, merging, splitting, etc). Used for operational logic and reporting; business logic dictates permissible values.

plainFields.name: effective_at
plainFields.description: Date and time the status became effective.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Business rationale or free-text explanation for status change (e.g., moderation reason, admin action, scheduled maintenance).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: pol_eco_board_board_histories
models.description: Preserves historical records of board assignments and organizational changes. Each record represents a structural or ownership change, such as moving a board between categories, reassigning responsibility, or other changes impacting board lineage and reporting. Supports full auditability of board organizational structure and facilitates operations reporting. References the relevant board, previous and new category, and the acting admin or moderator.

foreignFields.name: pol_eco_board_board_id
foreignFields.description: Board's {@link pol_eco_board_boards.id} related to this history change.

foreignFields.name: previous_category_id
foreignFields.description: The {@link pol_eco_board_categories.id} the board was previously assigned to (null if first assignment).

foreignFields.name: new_category_id
foreignFields.description: The {@link pol_eco_board_categories.id} the board is assigned to after the change.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: The {@link pol_eco_board_admins.id} admin who performed the change (if by admin).

foreignFields.name: actor_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: The {@link pol_eco_board_moderators.id} moderator who performed the change (if by moderator).

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Type of change (e.g., reassignment, merge, split, archive, ownership transfer). Business logic constrains allowed values, tracked for audit and reporting.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Business rationale or description for the change (optional), supporting audit trails and operational reporting.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the change occurred.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: pol_eco_board_moderator_board_assignments
models.description: Junction table linking moderators to boards, representing operational moderation assignments. Supports many-to-many mapping of which moderators are actively assigned to which boards. Tracks assignment start, end (if expired/removed), role transfer log, and assignment rationale. Enables runtime dashboards, compliance, and audit trails of moderator coverage for every board or sub-board. References boards and moderators from existing tables.

foreignFields.name: pol_eco_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator's {@link pol_eco_board_moderators.id} assigned to this board.

foreignFields.name: pol_eco_board_board_id
foreignFields.description: Board's {@link pol_eco_board_boards.id} for which this assignment applies.

plainFields.name: assigned_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: Admin's {@link pol_eco_board_admins.id} who assigned the moderator (nullable if self-assignment/automatic).

plainFields.name: assigned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp the assignment began (i.e. when the moderator was linked to the board).

plainFields.name: ended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp the assignment ended (null if currently active).

plainFields.name: role_transfer_log
plainFields.description: Optional log or notes regarding transfer of assignment or admin notes for audit. Useful for documenting manual overrides or special cases.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this assignment record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: pol_eco_board_posts
models.description: Primary business table for user-authored discussion posts. Each post represents an authored topic or thread under a specific category/board (referenced externally). Records immutable author, timestamps, and core data needed for content management, moderation, audit, and retention. Supports tagging, voting, comment chains, and moderation/reporting via separate tables. Stores only raw post data—no calculated aggregates. Historical edits captured in pol_eco_board_post_edits. Soft delete is enabled for retention/audit.

foreignFields.name: author_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged author's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id}. Immutable creator reference for traceability.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Category's {@link pol_eco_board_categories.id} for post organization and visibility. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Post title, required, business-validated length (10-120 chars), may not contain prohibited terms. Used for display, search, and navigation.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main body of the post content. Min: 10, Max: 10000 chars. Allows markdown or limited markup. Sanitized and validated on submission.

plainFields.name: comment_count
plainFields.description: Number of first-level comments. Updated by triggers for performance but not denormalized with business aggregates outside this table.

plainFields.name: view_count
plainFields.description: Number of times the post has been viewed. Used for engagement tracking. Not business critical but monitored for analytics.

plainFields.name: flagged
plainFields.description: True if post is flagged for moderation/review. Set by reporting/voting business rules or moderation actions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for post creation. Used for ordering and retention policies. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last edit or business update. Updated only by allowed business flows. Used by audit logic.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Set when deleted by user or moderator. Retained for audit period, NULL if active.

models.name: pol_eco_board_post_edits
models.description: Edit history and audit trail for all edits to pol_eco_board_posts. Each row is a snapshot of post content at a given edit. Used for moderation, accountability, and viewing edit history. Links to post, editor, and stores previous state. Not a materialized view—every revision is immutable. Permanent part of audit trail (no user deletions).

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Original post's {@link pol_eco_board_posts.id} being edited.

foreignFields.name: editor_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id} who performed the edit.

plainFields.name: edit_body
plainFields.description: Body content for edit snapshot. Full state of post body at the time of edit. Used for rollback and audit.

plainFields.name: edit_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for edit, supplied by editor or system. Required for moderation, optional for self-edits.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for edit operation (immutable).

models.name: pol_eco_board_comments
models.description: Primary business table for comments on posts. Supports threaded (single-level reply) discussion under each post. Authored by members. Each comment is associated to a post (pol_eco_board_posts), and has immutable author, timestamps, content, and moderation state. Edit and audit history in pol_eco_board_comment_edits.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Associated post's {@link pol_eco_board_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: author_member_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring member's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_comment_id
foreignFields.description: If reply-to is used, parent comment's {@link pol_eco_board_comments.id}. Null if top-level comment. Restricts to one reply level (no deep threading).

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment body. 5-1000 chars, applies content rule validations, trimmed and sanitized.

plainFields.name: flagged
plainFields.description: True if comment is flagged for moderation. Triggers workflow for moderator review.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time. Used for ordering and rate limits (e.g., member can't comment repeatedly within short period).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Latest edit/update time for audit. Must be kept current for edit workflows.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Null if active, otherwise holds time of deletion (retained for audit/compliance duration).

models.name: pol_eco_board_comment_edits
models.description: Edit history and audit trail for all edits to pol_eco_board_comments. Stores each change as immutable row referencing comment and editor. Permanent audit trail—no user deletions allowed. Used for rollback, moderation, and review of edit history.

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Comment's {@link pol_eco_board_comments.id} being edited.

foreignFields.name: editor_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id} who performed the edit.

plainFields.name: edit_body
plainFields.description: Body of the comment at time of edit. Full snapshot for rollback/audit.

plainFields.name: edit_reason
plainFields.description: Reason given for edit; may be user-entered or system-determined.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When edit operation occurred.

models.name: pol_eco_board_votes
models.description: Voting actions on posts/comments by eligible participants. Supports upvote/downvote for post or comment (one per member per item). Immutable business log of voting behavior for each content unit, with audit. Member, post or comment, and value (up/down) strictly recorded. Duplicate/invalid voting prevented by design. Used for both engagement display and moderation/escalation.

foreignFields.name: voter_member_id
foreignFields.description: Voter's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id}. Necessary for quota, abuse detection, and audit.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Voted post {@link pol_eco_board_posts.id}, if applies. Null if vote is on comment.

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Voted comment {@link pol_eco_board_comments.id}, if applies. Null if vote is on post.

plainFields.name: vote_value
plainFields.description: 1 for upvote, -1 for downvote. Used for efficient tally and abuse detection. Value must be in set {1, -1}; min/max constraints at business layer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the vote occurred. Used for rate limits and duplicate prevention.

models.name: pol_eco_board_tags
models.description: Tags available for categorizing posts. Used for search, filtering, and analytics, subject to admin management. Tags must be unique, normalized (slug), and cannot be deleted if in use (cascades managed at business/application layer).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Tag display name (case-insensitive unique constraint, validated for allowed chars/length 3-30).

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: Normalized slug for search/filter. Must be unique and lowercase (URL-safe).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Short human-friendly tag explanation (30-120 chars).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time for audit/history.

models.name: pol_eco_board_post_tags
models.description: Junction table mapping posts to tags (M:N relationship). Each row connects one post with one tag; together forms many-to-many mapping for filtering/search. No duplicates by unique composite index. Must reference only active posts/tags. No denormalized data.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to post {@link pol_eco_board_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: tag_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to tag {@link pol_eco_board_tags.id}.

plainFields.name: assigned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp specifying when the tag was applied to the post.

models.name: pol_eco_board_reports
models.description: User/member reports on posts or comments for abuse/inappropriateness. Includes reason, type, and optional description supplied by the reporter. Status of moderation report is managed in other domains (moderation can reference this ID for action). Each report links to exactly one post or comment (not both), and to the reporting member. Used for workflow triggering, abuse management, and analytics. Immutable for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: reporter_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id} who submitted the report. Audited for abuse prevention.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: If reporting a post, reference {@link pol_eco_board_posts.id}. Null if report targets a comment.

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: If reporting a comment, reference {@link pol_eco_board_comments.id}. Null if report targets a post.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Report type (e.g., spam, hate, off-topic, abuse, other). Must match business-validated admin codes.

plainFields.name: reason_description
plainFields.description: User-supplied optional description/details. Max length enforced at business layer (e.g., 250-400 chars).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When report was submitted. Used for review queue and escalation SLAs.

models.name: pol_eco_board_attachments
models.description: File attachments to posts. Each row represents a file uploaded and attached to a specific post by a member (author). Attachments follow business rules after post creation. File reference (uri) must be unique, and only permitted types/size enforced at application layer. Null deleted_at = active; soft delete for retention. Cascading deletion follows business and legal hold rules.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Parent post's {@link pol_eco_board_posts.id}. Must be active post.

foreignFields.name: author_member_id
foreignFields.description: Uploader's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id} (must match post author for ordinary attachments).

plainFields.name: uri
plainFields.description: Location/identifier for file in storage bucket. Immutable. Must be unique per attachment.

plainFields.name: file_name
plainFields.description: Original file name as supplied, used for display and audit.

plainFields.name: file_size_bytes
plainFields.description: File size in bytes. Limits enforced at application level (business rules: 10MB max/file, 20MB/post).

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: Detected MIME type (e.g., 'image/png'). Used for business acceptance and audit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time of upload/attachment.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Null if active.

models.name: pol_eco_board_moderation_actions
models.description: Represents a single moderation action (decision, removal, warning, etc.) taken on reported content. Each record captures the moderation activity, its executor (moderator/admin), linked report/reference object, operating context (post, comment, or user), action type, rationale, and status/result. This model creates a traceable primary record for every business or privilege-sensitive action, and serves as the authoritative source of action events for compliance or audit purposes. Links to pol_eco_board_reports for the underlying content or event. Also references staff identity via moderator or admin ids from existing user tables.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Moderated report's {@link pol_eco_board_reports.id}.

foreignFields.name: operator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator or admin's {@link pol_eco_board_moderators.id} or {@link pol_eco_board_admins.id}. (References either role according to context; use discriminator field in application logic).

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of moderation action (e.g., edit, remove, warn, suspend, escalate).

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Object of moderation (e.g., post, comment, user, attachment).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of this action (pending, completed, overruled, etc.).

plainFields.name: rationale
plainFields.description: Business reason, operator justification or notes. Required for auditability. Max 1000 chars.

plainFields.name: outcome
plainFields.description: Result/outcome of action (accepted, rejected, escalated, appealed, etc.)

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderation action was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time for this moderation action record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if this action was removed.

models.name: pol_eco_board_moderation_audits
models.description: Captures comprehensive audit logs for all moderation actions, including pre- and post-action state snapshots, actor identity, and audit metadata. Enables historical tracing and compliance review of all sensitive moderation processes. Every change to a moderation action (remove, edit, escalate) is logged here for transparency and dispute resolution. Links to both action and operator. Provides full visibility into the decision lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Related moderation action's {@link pol_eco_board_moderation_actions.id}.

foreignFields.name: auditor_id
foreignFields.description: Auditor (usually admin or lead moderator) identity, references {@link pol_eco_board_admins.id} or {@link pol_eco_board_moderators.id}. Use business logic to distinguish role.

plainFields.name: pre_state_snapshot
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON/text snapshot of moderation action before change. Max size 2000 chars.

plainFields.name: post_state_snapshot
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON/text snapshot after action. Max size 2000 chars.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the audit/change. Max 1000 chars.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Audit record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time for this audit record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: pol_eco_board_sanctions
models.description: Formal record of sanctions (temporary or permanent) issued as a result of moderation. Includes details about type, target (user/member/moderator), status, rationale, and duration. Links directly to the action and sanctioned entity for full audit trail. Used for account suspensions, bans, and other participation restrictions. All sanctions must be traceable to the initiating moderation action, with full compliance support.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Underlying moderation action that produced the sanction. {@link pol_eco_board_moderation_actions.id}.

foreignFields.name: sanctioned_user_id
foreignFields.description: User/member account subject to sanctioning. References {@link pol_eco_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: sanction_type
plainFields.description: Type of sanction (suspension, ban, warning, probation, cooldown).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Sanction status (active, expired, revoked, appealed, overruled).

plainFields.name: rationale
plainFields.description: Business reason or policy link for the sanction. Max 1000 chars.

plainFields.name: start_at
plainFields.description: When the sanction takes effect.

plainFields.name: end_at
plainFields.description: Scheduled end of sanction (null for permanent/indefinite).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation date/time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update date/time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if sanction is removed or redacted.

models.name: pol_eco_board_escalations
models.description: Tracks escalation events in the moderation process. Used when a case requires review by higher authority (e.g., admin-level review, legal, or risk escalation). Records triggering moderation action, escalation initiator, recipient (target admin), reason, and status. Ensures every escalated case has a controllable audit chain. Provides a paper trail for disputes, legal compliance, and risk management.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: The moderation action being escalated. {@link pol_eco_board_moderation_actions.id}.

foreignFields.name: escalator_id
foreignFields.description: User/Moderator initiating escalation. References {@link pol_eco_board_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: recipient_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin reviewing/escalated to. References {@link pol_eco_board_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason/notes for escalating the action. Up to 1000 chars.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Escalation status (pending, resolved, rejected).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: pol_eco_board_appeals
models.description: Represents user or moderator appeals against moderation outcomes. Each appeal is linked to the original action, includes the appellant (member or moderator), appeal reason, status, reviewed-by field, and outcome result. Supports full audit trail of business appeal and resolution logic for compliance. Allows users to contest sanctions or actions taken against them via properly controlled workflows.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: The moderation action being appealed. {@link pol_eco_board_moderation_actions.id}.

foreignFields.name: appellant_id
foreignFields.description: The user or moderator submitting the appeal. References {@link pol_eco_board_members.id} or {@link pol_eco_board_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: reviewer_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin or authorized moderator reviewing the appeal. References {@link pol_eco_board_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Appellant's rationale for requesting the appeal. Max 1000 chars.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Appeal status (pending, in_review, resolved, rejected, upheld, overruled).

plainFields.name: outcome
plainFields.description: Result of the appeal process. (approved, denied, modified, escalated)

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Appeal creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Appeal last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: pol_eco_board_notifications
models.description: Stores every notification event generated for users, including delivery status, event type, recipient linkage, and time stamps. Each record represents a single notification instance requiring delivery and history retention independent from participation or content actions. Links to the intended user (member, moderator, or admin) via foreign key, and optionally to the related provider and originating post/comment/report as appropriate. Enables audit trail for notifications and supports operational, compliance, and privacy purge requirements.

foreignFields.name: recipient_member_id
foreignFields.description: Recipient's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id}. References the user to whom the notification is delivered (can be member, moderator, or admin).

foreignFields.name: provider_id
foreignFields.description: Notification provider's {@link pol_eco_board_notification_providers.id}. Identifies the provider/service used for this notification attempt.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Business event type code or category, e.g., 'reply', 'moderation_action', 'report_status', 'admin_notice'. Used for filtering and analytics.

plainFields.name: related_object_id
plainFields.description: UUID of related business object (e.g., post, comment, report, etc.) for audit and navigation. References the source event but is not a foreign key to keep polymorphism. Can be null for global or system-wide notifications.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current delivery status of the notification (e.g., 'pending', 'delivered', 'failed'). Used for tracking and reporting.

plainFields.name: attempt_count
plainFields.description: Number of delivery attempts made so far for this notification event. Used for retry/backoff logic and audit.

plainFields.name: last_attempted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent delivery attempt for this notification. Updated on each send try, used for troubleshooting and audit.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when notification was successfully delivered. Set if and only if status is 'delivered'. Null otherwise.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Created timestamp for audit trail; when the notification was initially generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp; reflects status/attempt count updates.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for privacy purge. Null if notification is active.

models.name: pol_eco_board_notification_preferences
models.description: Holds explicit notification opt-in/out settings and channel preferences for each member, separated from user profile for privacy and audit clarity. Each row applies to a single user and event type/channel combination, supporting granular user control and compliance evidence.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: User's {@link pol_eco_board_members.id}. References the member whose preference is being recorded.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of event this preference relates to (e.g., 'reply', 'moderation_action', 'admin_notice').

plainFields.name: channel
plainFields.description: Delivery channel: 'email', 'push', 'in_app', or 'sms' (enumerate in application logic, not DB constraint at this level).

plainFields.name: opt_in
plainFields.description: Whether the member has explicitly opted in (true) or out (false) of this notification type/channel combination. Used for privacy and regulatory compliance.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp preference was first recorded. Supports opt-in/out consent auditability.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last preference change or user update.

models.name: pol_eco_board_notification_failures
models.description: Retains all failed notification delivery attempts, supporting technical diagnostics, reporting, and compliance audits. Each row records a failure for a specific notification, including provider, technical details, and timestamps. Enables operational and privacy retention policies for notification-specific failures.

foreignFields.name: notification_id
foreignFields.description: Associated notification's {@link pol_eco_board_notifications.id}. Each failure is tied to an attempted notification event.

foreignFields.name: provider_id
foreignFields.description: Provider involved in the failed delivery (references {@link pol_eco_board_notification_providers.id}). May be null where failure is internal to system and not a provider.

plainFields.name: failure_code
plainFields.description: Provider- or system-assigned error code describing the reason for failure (business-level string, not system enum).

plainFields.name: failure_message
plainFields.description: Human-readable summary of the failure cause, suitable for diagnostics, audit, and support.

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the failure was recorded or detected. Used for analytics and time-slicing incident review.

plainFields.name: resolution_status
plainFields.description: Resolution or status of the failure event: e.g., 'pending', 'resolved', 'permanent_failure'. For operational reporting and closure.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Created timestamp for record/audit. Indicates when the failure was entered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Updated timestamp to track changes in resolution/status.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for compliance or privacy purge, may be null if not yet deleted.

models.name: pol_eco_board_external_auth_providers
models.description: Represents authorized external authentication providers (e.g., Google, Facebook, Apple) integrated for polEcoBoard user sign-in flows. Used for compliance, audit, and dynamic provider switching. Each record uniquely identifies a provider, manages status (enabled/disabled), and stores privacy/compliance settings relevant to integration. Does not contain user authentication data.

plainFields.name: provider_name
plainFields.description: The human-readable name of the authentication provider (e.g., Google, Facebook, Apple).

plainFields.name: provider_key
plainFields.description: Unique internal key or code identifying the provider integration (e.g., 'google', 'facebook'). Used for configuration and provider switching.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the provider integration. Valid values: 'enabled', 'disabled', 'maintenance'. Enforces which providers are available to the system.

plainFields.name: privacy_policy_uri
plainFields.description: The URI to the provider's privacy policy for compliance display to users.

plainFields.name: data_residency_region
plainFields.description: Region/jurisdiction where user data processed by this provider is stored or resides (ISO region/country code, e.g., 'US', 'EU').

plainFields.name: consent_required
plainFields.description: Specifies whether explicit user consent is required for this provider integration per privacy/compliance rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of provider record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last record update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion, or null if active.

models.name: pol_eco_board_third_party_audit_logs
models.description: Tracks all events, actions, and error responses from external integrations (e.g., authentication, analytics, anti-spam, notification providers) for compliance/audit purposes. Each log entry records source provider, event type, event payload (as JSON/string), timestamp, system result code, and related correlation information, supporting troubleshooting, legal hold, and system incident management.

plainFields.name: provider_key
plainFields.description: Internal code identifying which external provider generated the event (e.g., 'google', 'analytics', 'anti_spam').

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type or category of event logged (e.g., 'auth_flow_start', 'auth_flow_error', 'api_call', 'token_refresh', 'notification_send', 'fallback').

plainFields.name: event_payload
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON string or encoded payload of the event as received from or sent to the external provider.

plainFields.name: result_code
plainFields.description: Internal result code or error indicator derived from processing the provider event (e.g., 'success', 'failure', 'timeout', 'invalid_token').

plainFields.name: correlation_id
plainFields.description: Optional provider, system, or business correlation/trace ID for boundary tracking across systems (e.g., trace IDs for business audit).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

models.name: pol_eco_board_analytics_events
models.description: Stores anonymized, structured events transmitted to analytics platforms (e.g., page view, post creation, vote action, login) for operational/business intelligence and compliance. Each record supports audit requirements, regional reporting, and opt-in/out model. Not linked to user identities to preserve privacy. Data is purged or aggregated as per retention rules.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Business-defined type of analytics event (e.g., 'page_view', 'login', 'vote', 'moderation_action').

plainFields.name: session_anon_id
plainFields.description: Anonymized session identifier (non-PII, no user linkage), used for statistical correlation of analytics events by session or cohort.

plainFields.name: user_role
plainFields.description: User role associated with the event (e.g., 'guest', 'member', 'moderator', 'admin'). Used for business segmentation.

plainFields.name: event_details
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded details or metadata specific to the analytics event (e.g., category, target_id, feature usage); varies by event_type.

plainFields.name: region
plainFields.description: Region or jurisdiction associated with the event/session (data residency, reporting compliance; ISO country/region code).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the analytics event was generated.

models.name: pol_eco_board_anti_spam_events
models.description: Captures event records for all interactions with anti-spam/abuse prevention integrations (inbound or outbound events). Stores provider, operation, content hash, action outcome, score, and related metadata for audit and investigation, supporting appeals, escalations, and incident reviews. Does not store original user content (use hash/fingerprint only).

plainFields.name: provider_key
plainFields.description: Unique internal code or key for the integrated anti-spam provider (e.g., 'akismet', 'custom_1').

plainFields.name: operation
plainFields.description: Business or technical operation performed (e.g., 'content_submit', 'abuse_check', 'appeal', 'score_retrieval').

plainFields.name: content_hash
plainFields.description: Hash or digital fingerprint of content analyzed (never stores raw user content; only hashed to protect privacy).

plainFields.name: score
plainFields.description: Numeric risk or abuse probability score output from the provider (e.g., 0.00 to 1.00; higher is more risky).

plainFields.name: action_taken
plainFields.description: Result of anti-spam event or system action (e.g., 'approved', 'blocked', 'escalated', 'queued', 'error').

plainFields.name: appeal_requested
plainFields.description: Indicates if appeal process (user- or moderator-initiated) was requested for this event.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when anti-spam event was recorded.

models.name: pol_eco_board_consent_statuses
models.description: Stores all explicit consent and opt-in/out statuses by provider, data region, and integration use, supporting regulatory compliance for user and session privacy. Tracks what was consented to, for which provider, by which region/session/date, and manages enforcement of business/legal data flows. No PII is stored (refer to session/user separately in other domains for linkage).

plainFields.name: provider_key
plainFields.description: The unique key or code for the provider or integration to which consent applies (e.g., 'analytics', 'auth', 'notification').

plainFields.name: region
plainFields.description: Jurisdiction or regional code relevant to the consent (for data residency and privacy enforcement, ISO format).

plainFields.name: consent_type
plainFields.description: Type of consent (e.g., 'analytics', 'email_marketing', 'third_party', 'profiling').

plainFields.name: consent_status
plainFields.description: Status of the consent. Valid values: 'opt_in', 'opt_out', 'revoked', 'pending'.

plainFields.name: session_anon_id
plainFields.description: Anonymized session or cohort identifier related to this consent record (no PII/user identity stored).

plainFields.name: audit_trail
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded object/log with consent action metadata (e.g., time, source, device, evidence), for compliance audit. No PII included.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the consent status was recorded.

models.name: pol_eco_board_notification_providers
models.description: Catalogs all external notification providers (e.g., SendGrid, Twilio Email, SMTP, SMS) integrated with the service. Each record defines supported channels, endpoint URIs, operational status, provider region, configuration metadata (non-secret), and business flags for routing/fallback logic. Used for compliance transparency and operational provider switching.

plainFields.name: provider_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the notification provider (e.g., 'SendGrid', 'Twilio').

plainFields.name: provider_key
plainFields.description: Unique internal key/code representing notification integration (e.g., 'sendgrid', 'twilio_sms').

plainFields.name: channels_supported
plainFields.description: Comma-separated string of notification channels supported by this provider (e.g., 'email,sms,push').

plainFields.name: endpoint_uri
plainFields.description: Integration endpoint URI for provider's main API/service (primary endpoint, not credential/secret).

plainFields.name: region
plainFields.description: Provider's service or business region, for data residency and routing (ISO country/region code).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current operational status of the provider: 'active', 'inactive', or 'maintenance'.

plainFields.name: config_metadata
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded key/value mapping of non-secret configuration and operational metadata (supported features, documentation links, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of provider record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last provider config update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion, or null if active.

models.name: pol_eco_board_operational_logs
models.description: Centralized log of all system operations, events, and service activities for the polEcoBoard platform. Captures timestamped records of API calls, backend jobs, system notifications, performance events, and other significant operational actions for audit and monitoring. Provides a historical record to support incident investigation, compliance verification, and operational analytics.

plainFields.name: log_level
plainFields.description: Severity or categorization of the operational event (e.g., INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL). Used for triaging and dashboard filtering.

plainFields.name: logged_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the operational log entry was recorded.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Human-readable description or summary of the operational event. Designed for audit readability and system monitoring dashboards.

plainFields.name: context
plainFields.description: Structured or serialized metadata providing extra context for the operational event (e.g., job type, subsystem, trace ID, related resource identifiers).

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Optional reference to the involved admin, moderator, or automated system actor. May be null if operation is system-initiated or anonymous.

plainFields.name: event_code
plainFields.description: Internal code or short identifier for the event type, supporting analytic and automation use-cases (e.g. 'SIGN_IN', 'BACKUP_START', 'MAINTENANCE_NOTICE').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Log record creation timestamp (for soft-deletion and audit lifecycle control).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Log record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if log is active.

models.name: pol_eco_board_audit_trails
models.description: Immutable, write-once audit trail storing high-sensitivity business and system change records required for compliance reviews, security monitoring, and regulatory audits. Includes detailed context for all critical actions (e.g., config changes, access grants/revocations, data retention actions, incident resolutions).

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of audited action (e.g., CONFIG_CHANGE, ROLE_ASSIGN, DATA_ERASURE, INCIDENT_RESOLVE).

plainFields.name: performed_by_id
plainFields.description: ID of admin or privileged actor responsible for the action.

plainFields.name: target_resource
plainFields.description: Unique or composite identifier of the resource subject to the action (could be user id, config id, or resource URI).

plainFields.name: audit_context
plainFields.description: Structured or serialized details about action, pre/post state, or business justification.

plainFields.name: recorded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit trail entry was written (immutable once set).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Audit entry creation timestamp (redundant for retention lifecycle and index support).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Audit entry last update timestamp (in principle, should not change except for retention lifecycle metadata changes).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null means audit entry is live and protected from purge.

models.name: pol_eco_board_incidents
models.description: Service incident management and business-impact event log for polEcoBoard. Stores all critical or sustained operational incident reports, including outages, degraded services, compliance issues, data breaches, and legal events. Records allow for lifecycle tracking, business review, and regulatory reporting.

plainFields.name: incident_code
plainFields.description: Unique, short string code for the business or operational incident (e.g., OUTAGE_2024_05, GDPR_BREACH_001).

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Classification of the incident (e.g., OUTAGE, BREACH, COMPLIANCE, LEGAL, MAINTENANCE). Used for admin filtering and regulatory response.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current business status of the incident (e.g., OPEN, RESOLVED, ESCALATED, UNDER_REVIEW, CLOSED).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Summary of what happened, business impact, and affected services/users.

plainFields.name: detected_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the incident was first detected (may be earlier than creation for retroactive records).

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: When the incident was resolved or marked as closed; null for ongoing/outstanding incidents.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit and operational lifecycle management.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if still primary record.

models.name: pol_eco_board_maintenance_windows
models.description: Scheduled and historical system maintenance windows, covering downtimes, upgrades, migrations, and other planned/unplanned service interruptions. Supports platform status dashboards, incident correlation, and regulatory notifications. Used for compliance tracking and SLA verification.

plainFields.name: window_code
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance window event (e.g., MAINT_2025Q1, HOTFIX_20240615).

plainFields.name: start_time
plainFields.description: Scheduled or actual maintenance window start timestamp.

plainFields.name: end_time
plainFields.description: Scheduled or actual maintenance window end timestamp; null if still ongoing or if unplanned duration.

plainFields.name: expected_impact
plainFields.description: Human-readable summary of expected service impact; for admin and compliance dashboarding.

plainFields.name: actual_impact
plainFields.description: Recorded impact as determined post-event.

plainFields.name: notified_at
plainFields.description: Time when admins/moderators were notified of the scheduled/unscheduled maintenance event.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, null if still in operational window history.

models.name: pol_eco_board_service_metrics
models.description: Aggregated, time-bucketed service-level metrics supporting operational dashboards, business KPI tracking, and SLA verification for polEcoBoard. Metrics include post/comment/vote counts, user activity, moderation actions, response times, operational error frequencies, and retention/purge statistics. Only computed via backend aggregation; no denormalized materialized view pattern needed.

plainFields.name: metric_code
plainFields.description: Short string code identifying metric type (e.g., POST_COUNT, COMMENT_COUNT, VOTE_VOLUME, API_LATENCY, INCIDENT_COUNT, PURGE_VOLUME).

plainFields.name: metric_window_start
plainFields.description: Start of the aggregation time window (e.g., hour, day, week).

plainFields.name: metric_window_end
plainFields.description: End of the aggregation window (exclusive).

plainFields.name: value_int
plainFields.description: Integer-valued metric (e.g., count of events, users, incidents in the window).

plainFields.name: value_double
plainFields.description: Floating-point metric (e.g., average latency, percent completion, ratio). Only one of value_int or value_double typically used per metric by code convention.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional business note or free-form annotation to explain anomalies or correlate business events with metric deviations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the metric aggregation entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last time metric was updated (e.g., for amended calculations or corrected data).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, for retention/purge control. Null if active.

models.name: pol_eco_board_business_reports
models.description: Business event report entry for admin dashboards, export/audit actions, scheduled metrics, regulatory filings, or compliance reviews. Covers both automatically and manually triggered reports, their configuration, delivery status, and role in audit trail. Enables tracking, lifecycle management, and historical analysis of all formal business report objects.

plainFields.name: report_code
plainFields.description: Short string code or business key identifying the report (e.g., WEEKLY_METRICS_20240810, INCIDENT_EXPORT_20250515).

plainFields.name: report_type
plainFields.description: Business categorization of the report (e.g., METRICS, AUDIT, INCIDENTS, EXPORT, SLA, LEGAL, COMPLIANCE).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Report status in the report lifecycle (e.g., PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED, DELIVERED).

plainFields.name: requested_by_id
plainFields.description: Admin or system service account that initiated the business report request or generation.

plainFields.name: content_uri
plainFields.description: Location or reference (e.g., S3 URI) of the generated report document or export file.

plainFields.name: triggered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report generation/export was started.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when report was delivered or made available for download; null for pending reports.

plainFields.name: failure_reason
plainFields.description: If the report failed to complete or deliver, this provides the reason or error context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp on report object creation (for lifecycle and retention tracking).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (for report lifecycle changes).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if report record is active.

### `pol_eco_board_categories`

Top-level taxonomy for discussion boards. Defines unique, human-visible
categories that organize and classify all board content. Referenced by
[pol_eco_board_boards](#pol_eco_board_boards) for structural organization. Immutable
except for changes to name, description, or display order. Board and user
content models reference this category but do not own category records.
Provides hierarchical and navigational structure but contains no
user-generated content. Used system-wide for filtering, searching, and
permission gating.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`
  > Unique name of the category as displayed to users. Title-cased, 2–60
  > characters, represents top-level classification (e.g., 'International
  > Affairs').
- `description`
  > Free-text category description for web UI and moderation guidance.
  > Explains topic focus, allowed content themes, and usage. Optional but
  > strongly recommended; up to 255 characters.
- `display_order`
  > Integer specifying appearance order in navigation and category lists
  > (ascending). Configurable by admins for optimal UX.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of initial category creation via admin workflow.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of most recent update to any field (name, description,
  > display_order).

### `pol_eco_board_boards`

Defines a top-level forum board/section on the platform, each belonging
to exactly one category ([pol_eco_board_categories](#pol_eco_board_categories)). A board is a
logical container for posts, with unique name and code. Board
configuration includes description, display order, visibility, and
archival state. This model does not directly reference user participation
or moderation assignments (handled in separate tables). Used for display
navigation, permission gate, and board-level operations. Does not store
content; used for board definitions only.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_eco_board_category_id`
  > Assigned category's [pol_eco_board_categories.id](#pol_eco_board_categories). Each board is
  > assigned to exactly one active category for taxonomic organization and
  > navigation.
- `name`
  > Unique, human-readable board title. Displayed prominently in navigation.
  > 2–60 characters, may overlap category names for consistency but globally
  > unique per board.
- `code`
  > Unique, machine-friendly identifier for the board; used in URLs, admin
  > operations, and as an external integration key. 2–30 lowercase letters,
  > numbers, and underscores.
- `description`
  > Optional board description for user guidance and moderation policy. Up to
  > 255 characters.
- `is_public`
  > Whether the board is visible to non-authenticated (guest) users. Used for
  > UI filtering and role-based access control.
- `is_archived`
  > True if the board is archived (closed for new posts/comments but viewable
  > by privileged roles/admins). Used for compliance and operational
  > reporting.
- `display_order`
  > Integer that determines board order in the navigation lists. Lower values
  > display earlier (ascending sort). Admin-configurable for UX.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of board creation.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of last update to board settings, description, or archival
  > state.
- `deleted_at`
  > Timestamp if board is logically deleted (soft delete). Null unless
  > deleted. Used for audit trails, never physically removed from database.

### `pol_eco_board_service_settings`

Singleton table for global service configuration and feature toggles.
Contains a single record (enforced in application logic) specifying
current values for platform-level settings, system flags, and
business-critical constants (e.g., max post length, registration enabled,
enforcement deadlines, notification toggles, retention periods). Updated
rarely by admins. No user-generated content. Read at app startup. All
service domains reference this table for system-wide parameters but do
not own or update these fields independently. Record is never deleted or
replaced, only updated.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `registration_enabled`
  > Enables or disables new user registration across the platform. If false,
  > registration endpoints and workflows are disabled for all users. Managed
  > by admins during maintenance, emergencies, or policy changes.
- `max_post_length`
  > Maximum number of characters allowed in a post's body as enforced by
  > business and moderation policy.
- `max_comment_length`
  > Maximum number of characters permitted in a comment's body. Used for
  > input validation and error messaging.
- `default_board_visibility`
  > Default value for new board's is_public field when created by admins.
  > Guides admin workflow UX.
- `data_retention_days`
  > System-wide setting (in days) for minimum data retention period for
  > posts, comments, and audit logs before they're eligible for purge per
  > policy. Audited by compliance systems.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when service settings record was first created. Set once.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of any change to configuration or business flags. Updated
  > automatically on every change.

### `pol_eco_board_guests`

Guest users who access the application without registration; provides a
tracked, anonymous footprint for session observation, abuse/IP recording,
and guest-to-member analytics. Powers project-level metrics for
non-authenticated participation including consent status.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `ip_address`: IP address of the guest for session tracking and abuse prevention.
- `device_fingerprint`
  > Device fingerprint or anonymized browser identifier to distinguish unique
  > guest sessions.
- `consent_status`
  > Current consent or privacy agreement status text/code for this guest
  > interaction.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the guest session was created.
- `updated_at`: When the guest session record was last updated.

### `pol_eco_board_members`

Registered member accounts, each a unique, verified user. Handles
profile, security, lifecycle, audit, and privacy settings for all core
platform business. Required for any posting, voting, or reporting.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`: Unique verified email address. Used for login and notifications.
- `password_hash`: Hashed password (never plaintext); always required for authentication.
- `display_name`: Public display name; unique within platform locale.
- `profile_image_uri`: Profile picture URI or file reference; optional at registration.
- `consent_status`: Active privacy/consent agreement version for this member.
- `is_active`: Is member active (not banned/deactivated/deleted)?
- `last_login_at`: Last successful login time.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for the member.
- `updated_at`: Last update to member account.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the member is deleted or banned.

### `pol_eco_board_moderators`

Moderator accounts elevated from members for content/business enforcement
powers. Tracks appointment and privileges, with references to both the
member and the appointing admin.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `member_id`: Reference to pol_eco_board_members.id this moderator extends.
- `appointed_by_admin_id`
  > Admin who granted moderator privileges; references
  > pol_eco_board_admins.id.
- `appointed_at`: Date/time when moderator role was granted.
- `revoked_at`: If privileges stripped; otherwise null when active.
- `is_active`: If this moderator's privileges are currently active.
- `created_at`: Timestamp the moderator record was created.
- `updated_at`: Last moderator record update.

### `pol_eco_board_admins`

Platform/system admins with authority for all
security/policy/analytics/role management. Each record links an admin to
the promoting admin and to their member account for full accountability.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `member_id`: Reference to member this admin extends (pol_eco_board_members.id).
- `privilege_level`
  > Numeric admin privilege level (0=standard admin, up to 10 for full super
  > admins).
- `appointed_by_admin_id`: Admin who approved this account (self-referential for first/creator).
- `appointed_at`: When admin privileges were first granted.
- `revoked_at`: If privileges are revoked or demoted, when it happened.
- `is_active`: Is this admin active and able to exercise admin powers?
- `created_at`: Admin record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last admin record update.

### `pol_eco_board_auth_sessions`

Tracks all authentication sessions for members (JWT, refresh tokens,
SSO). Stores token hash, issued/expiry/revoke, IP/device metadata, audit
info. Used for login management, security, and compliance.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `member_id`
  > Foreign key to pol_eco_board_members.id representing the account for this
  > session.
- `access_token`: Hash of last issued JWT access token (never raw/plaintext).
- `refresh_token`: Hash of active refresh token (never plaintext).
- `ip_address`: IP address from which session was created.
- `device_fingerprint`: Device/browser fingerprint, for tracking unique sessions.
- `provider`: Authentication provider used: 'native', 'google', 'sso-...', etc.
- `user_agent`: User agent string for device/browser diagnostics.
- `issued_at`: When this session/JWT was issued.
- `expires_at`: Session expiry timestamp.
- `revoked_at`: If revoked, when session/token was terminated; null if active.
- `created_at`: Session record created at.
- `updated_at`: When session record was last updated.

### `pol_eco_board_role_transitions`

Records all role (member/moderator/admin) transitions: promotions,
demotions, requests, approvals. Tracks the account affected, approving
admin, status, and all audit trail fields.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `account_id`
  > The affected account ID (member, moderator, or admin). {@link
  > pol_eco_board_members.id} or derived types.
- `approved_by_admin_id`: Admin who approved this transition. [pol_eco_board_admins.id](#pol_eco_board_admins)
- `origin_role`: Original role for the affected account: guest, member, moderator, admin.
- `destination_role`: Role after the transition: member, moderator, admin, revoked.
- `reason`
  > Explanation or business justification for transition (may be
  > user-requested, policy, or system action).
- `status`: Transition status: pending, completed, rejected, or cancelled.
- `requested_at`: When the transition was initiated.
- `approved_at`: Time transition was approved (null if not finalized).
- `created_at`: Transition record creation.
- `updated_at`: Last update for this transition record.

### `pol_eco_board_account_audits`

Comprehensive audit trail recording all actions on members, moderators,
admins. Logs who did it, who was affected, type/status of business
action, and business/technical metadata for compliance/audit. Enables
investigation, incident response, and retention.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `actor_id`
  > ID of the account performing the action. [pol_eco_board_members.id](#pol_eco_board_members)
  > or derived.
- `target_account_id`: ID of the account affected. [pol_eco_board_members.id](#pol_eco_board_members) or derived.
- `action_type`
  > Business event: create, update, password_change, ban,
  > privilege_escalation, role_transition, session_invalidate, etc.
- `action_metadata`
  > JSON-encoded metadata or reference for audit: external system reference,
  > business justification, etc.
- `event_source`
  > Where event was triggered: API, admin UI, scheduled_job,
  > external_integration, etc.
- `status`: Outcome: success, failure, pending, error (for audit chains).
- `occurred_at`: When this event took place.
- `created_at`: When audit record was written.
